Vocab: Each token ID and its bytes.
Grammar.from_json_schema: Parses a [JSON Schema](https://github.com/IsaacBreen/glrmask/blob/main/GUIDE.md#grammar-formats), given as JSON text or a dict.
Grammar.bind: Binds externs by name. If one fails, none are bound.
Module.bind: Binds externs by name. If one fails, none are bound.
Module.precompile: Compiles what it can for `vocab` now, even with externs unbound.
Module.compile: Reuses any precompiled work, which must be for the same vocabulary.
Module.load: Loads what `save()` wrote, in the same GLRMask version.
Constraint: A compiled grammar, ready to use.
Constraint.mask_bit_len: The mask's length in bits: one per token ID, from 0.
Constraint.load: Loads what `save()` wrote, in the same GLRMask version and with the vocab it was compiled with.
ConstraintState: The state of one generated sequence.
ConstraintState.mask: Which tokens may come next: one bit per token ID in `uint32` words (bit `i % 32` of word `i // 32`), or one boolean per token ID with `dtype=bool`.
ConstraintState.fill_mask: Like `mask()`, but writes the words into `bitmask`. Extra words are set to 0. Releases the GIL.
ConstraintState.mask_bit_len: The mask's length in bits: one per token ID, from 0.
ConstraintState.commit_token: If the token isn't allowed, returns `False` and the state ends.
ConstraintState.commit_tokens: Commits tokens in order until one isn't allowed, which ends the state. Returns how many were committed.
ConstraintState.commit_bytes: If the bytes aren't allowed, returns `False` and the state ends.
ConstraintState.forced_bytes: The bytes that must come next, if any. Commit them with `commit_bytes()`.
ConstraintState.is_accepting: Whether the output so far is a complete match.
ConstraintState.is_terminated: Whether nothing more can be committed.
MaskStrategy: A preference for faster compiling or faster masks.
MaskStrategy.AUTO: Currently `FAST_MASKS`, or whatever the module was precompiled with.
MaskStrategy.FAST_COMPILE: Prefer faster compiling over faster masks.
MaskStrategy.FAST_MASKS: Prefer faster masks over faster compiling.
Externs: A read-only mapping of extern names to `Extern`.
Extern: A named placeholder in a grammar.
Extern.kind: What the extern can be bound to.
GLRMaskError.kind: One of `"syntax"`, `"invalid_input"`, `"compilation"`, `"resource_limit"`, `"strategy_unsupported"`, `"serialization"`, `"internal"`. More may be added.
